messages:
zoe: Hey folks, opened PR to clarify Dedicated provisioning docs: tightened SLA language around eviction windows, added a compact SDK + YAML example for the new scale_policy fields (eviction_delay_seconds, grace_period), and added an explicit 429 error payload example for callers. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1621

zoe: please focus review on two things: (1) wording that avoids implying eviction is guaranteed, (2) the field names in the example match infra catalog.

ethan: quick peek — love the shorter timeline paragraph. one suggestion: replace "eviction after X" with "fallback evaluation after X may lead to eviction depending on tenant priority and fallback_policy." less legalese but safer.

claire: agree with ethan. also adding a short expected UX latency line helps product: "approx scale-up latency: 200ms (warm), 1-4s (cold)."

zoe: adding those. dropping the YAML snippet here for visibility:
```yaml
scale_policy:
  mode: autoscale
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  eviction_delay_seconds: 120
  grace_period_seconds: 30
  queue_limit: 300
  fallback_policy: "reserved_pool_fallback"
```

claire: looks good. infra-eng: confirm fallback_policy name matches infra catalog (docs currently use dash vs underscore variants).

infra-eng: thanks — infra catalog uses `reserved_pool_fallback` (underscore). we'll add a docs note to avoid drift. also confirming semantics: eviction is a last-resort fallback after scale-up attempts and fallback evaluation; it is not immediate at eviction_delay expiration, it's a trigger for evaluation.

zoe: perfect phrasing to include: "After eviction_delay_seconds elapses and fallback evaluation finds insufficient capacity, lower-priority tenants may be evicted per fallback_policy." claire prefers we add "may be".

ethan: dropping the API error payload example we'll include so caller teams can implement backoff and fallback routing:
```json
{
  "error": "tenant_queue_saturated",
  "status": 429,
  "retry_after_seconds": 45,
  "suggested_action": "backoff_or_failover_region"
}
```

zoe: i18n-bot: please add translator context lines for the 429 message and the SLA sentence. we want translators to know these are instructions for callers, not legal guarantees.

i18n-bot: added: // context: 429 indicates temporary queue saturation; callers should back off and may route requests to another region.
i18n-bot: added: // context: explains that eviction is a potential outcome of fallback evaluation and depends on tenant priority and available capacity.

docs-ci: linkcheck: found broken anchor -> #eviction-timeline (line 120)

zoe: thanks CI. i've updated the cross-link to #fallback-evaluation-timeline in the branch. pushing a tiny commit now.

claire: editorial nit: shorten the FAQ entry to two bullets: (a) when 429 vs preemption responses occur, (b) what callers should do. keeps it scannable.

infra-eng: one more infra note: we'll add an alias in the catalog to accept `reserved-pool-fallback` for one release to avoid churn. mention that in docs.

zoe: plan: ethan will do a final copyedit, infra-eng will confirm alias timeline, i18n-bot added contexts, claire will simplify FAQ bullets. i'll merge after CI green. target: EOD. :rocket:
